newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tampella name change to Tamrock approved.
newsitem.headline: Tampella name change to Tamrock approved.

text.p: An extraordinary meeting of shareholders in Finnish engineering group Oy Tampella Ab endorsed a change of the company's name to Tamrock Oy, the company said in a statement on Friday.

The name change will take effect "early this year" once it is entered in the Central Trade Register, at the same time as Tampella's Tamrock unit is merged with Oy Tampella Ab in line with an earlier decision, it said.
Mining equipment maker Tamrock is Tampella's biggest business group. Its January-August 1996 net sales of 2.27 billion markka accounted for almost 80 percent of Tampella's net sales.
